major_cooldowns.name: Summon Darkglare
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Summon Darkglare before you chain-cast Unstable Affliction so its dot damage amp covers their whole duration.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Harvest
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Sync Dark Harvest into your Summon Darkglare window and only fire it when the shards it grants will not overcap you.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base_cd_s is 60; the guide states Cull the Weak brings it to roughly 40 seconds as talented, so 40 is used here.

major_cooldowns.name: Malevolence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pair Malevolence with every Summon Darkglare cast; it stacks 6 more onto each active Wither and buffs your haste.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Hellcaller capstone, only 1/3 sampled parses cast it since most sampled logs were Soul Harvester.

major_cooldowns.name: Blood Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pop Blood Fury alongside your other damage cooldowns, ideally inside a Summon Darkglare window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Orc racial, only relevant to players of that race.

defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Use Unending Resolve to cut a big chunk of incoming damage during a heavy raid damage window.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Use Dark Pact for a self shield before predictable damage, it drains extra health from your pet if one is out.

defensives.name: Mortal Coil
defensives.usage_rule: Use Mortal Coil to horror an attacker off you while healing yourself for a chunk of your max health.

rules.description: Precast Haunt, then Agony on pull
rules.action: Precast Haunt so it lands as combat starts, then apply Agony as your first cast on pull.

rules.description: Hold Unstable Affliction for Summon Darkglare
rules.action: Pool your chain-cast Unstable Affliction until Summon Darkglare is out so its full duration sits under the dot amp.
Line Malevolence up with each Summon Darkglare cast so its Wither stacking and haste buff land in the same window.

rules.description: Use Seed of Corruption on multiple targets
rules.action: Cast Seed of Corruption as many times as possible once several enemies are up, keeping only a handful of Agony ticking alongside it.

rules.description: Keep Agony ticking on the target
rules.action: Refresh Agony before it falls off, and reapply it even while moving rather than letting it lapse.

rules.description: Do not overcap Soul Shards from Dark Harvest
rules.action: Check your Soul Shards will not overcap before casting Dark Harvest, spend shards down first if they are close to full.

rules.description: Spend Nightfall procs on Drain Soul or Shadow Bolt
rules.action: Weave a Drain Soul or Shadow Bolt in as soon as Nightfall procs instead of letting it expire.

rules.description: Spend Shard Instability on Unstable Affliction or Seed
rules.action: Cash in Shard Instability on a free Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption right away instead of overcapping it.
